subject: science
title: Life Around Us · Q1 W01 D01
objective: Classify familiar examples as living or non-living and describe basic needs or body parts.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ Living things grow, need resources, and respond to their surroundings. Plants and animals have parts that help them live. Ready to explore?

vocabulary.definition: something that grows, needs food and water, and can respond
something that does not grow or need food and water
something a living thing must have to live, like food and water
